items.question: What is ChatCanvas?
items.answer: ChatCanvas is Lovart's infinite spatial workspace where you brief an AI design agent, generate assets, compare variants, and refine output — all in one persistent canvas.

items.question: How is ChatCanvas different from Lovart chat?
items.answer: Chat is the conversation layer. ChatCanvas is where generations land spatially — arranged, compared, edited, and exported as a production surface.

items.question: Do my canvases persist?
items.answer: Yes. Canvases, generation history, and context persist across sessions. You can maintain multiple canvases per project or client.

items.question: Can I use Touch Edit on canvas?
items.answer: Yes. Touch Edit, Text Edit, and Edit Elements work directly on canvas elements — no re-export to another tool.

items.question: Does Brand Kit apply inside ChatCanvas?
items.answer: Yes. Active Brand Kit rules apply to new generations and edits within any canvas session.

items.question: Can teams share canvases?
items.answer: Team plans support shared workspaces so stakeholders can review variant boards and approved directions together.
